summary: Luda Technology Group Limited filed a Form 6-K with a press release dated September 8, 2026, announcing implementation of an AI-enabled multi-agent inquiry and quotation system to accelerate order processing. The system reduces average quotation time from 30 to 3 minutes, uses Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 model, and operates with human-in-the-loop oversight. CEO Ma Biu commented on digital transformation. This is a routine operational press release, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, shareholder actions, or strategic changes are involved. No special-situation category applies.
